## Scientific question

How can heterogeneous biological, fisheries, spatial, and environmental indicators be integrated into transparent and interpretable diagnostics of stock and ecosystem state?

## Scope

This programme develops frameworks for combining indicators without obscuring their ecological meaning, temporal behaviour, uncertainty, or management relevance.

## Methods

- Indicator screening, redundancy analysis, and dimensional reduction.
- Selection of representative indicators and assessment of domain dominance.
- Transformation, standardization, biological orientation, and weighting diagnostics.
- Dynamic and static multivariate integration.
- Sensitivity, uncertainty, and robustness analysis.
- Change-point, regime, and threshold detection.
- Pressure–state interpretation and management-oriented visualization.

## Current status

Active methodological programme associated with multidimensional anchovy stock-state analyses and broader pressure–state applications in marine and fisheries assessment.

## Expected outputs

- Multivariate indicator frameworks and diagnostic protocols.
- Peer-reviewed manuscripts and conference contributions.
- Reproducible code for indicator construction and evaluation.
- Visual products for communicating multidimensional stock condition.

## Repository architecture

This is a programme-level record. Method-specific software and paper repositories will be linked as independent source-of-truth components after their repository audits.
